pull.title: MINOR: Migrate Admin client timeout integration tests to Java
pull.body:
Migrate the Admin client timeout and close tests from
PlaintextAdminIntegrationTest to AdminClientTimeoutIntegrationTest. The
timeoutMs(0) tests now use assertTimeout to verify the option timeout is
honored, and tests that only need an invalid broker run with `@Test`
instead of `@ClusterTest`.

Reviewers: Chia-Ping Tsai <chia7712@gmail.com>

repo.name: kafka
repo.description: Apache Kafka - A distributed event streaming platform

review_comments.body: Could you use `assertTimeout` to ensure that `timeoutMs(0)` actually works? Otherwise, the test still passes even if it takes 60 seconds to throw the `ExecutionException`.

testDescribeConfigWithOptionTimeoutMs
testDescribeUserScramCredentialsTimeout
testDescribeTransactionsTimeout
testAbortTransactionTimeout
testListClientMetricsResourcesTimeoutMs	
testListConfigResourcesTimeoutMs

Those test cases have analoguous issues
Updated. The tests now use `assertTimeout` with the same 10- and 30-second limits as the previous Scala tests.

It seems those tests don't need the cluster instance, so would you mind using `@Test` instead? `testCallInFlightTimeouts` and `testClose` still need the cluster, so please inject `ClusterInstance` as a method parameter for those two instead of via the constructor :)

issue_comments.body: BTW, could you migrate `testDelayedClose` and `testAdminClientHandlingBadIPWithoutTimeout` as well?

> BTW, could you migrate `testDelayedClose` and `testAdminClientHandlingBadIPWithoutTimeout` as well?

Migrated both tests.
